original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.

original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: For G=UT3(F2), determine the exact minimum paid rank-one gate count for diag([xyxy],[xyxy],[1]) on three arbitrary dirty registers using labels x,y, all 28 rank-one idempotents of M3(F2), and arbitrary free GL3(F2) mixing normalized by augmentation.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card is broad. This narrows it to the explicit unresolved third-dirty-register extension of the exact two-register D8 central-commutator result, changing the role count from two to three while fixing the group, target, and paid alphabet.
bottleneck_link: A third dirty role could in principle let a bit supplier share paid work. This result is a formal scalar-cost side bound only: it finds no saving even with free GL3 mixing, and does not price physical hosting or alter the selected recursive profile.
stop_rule: Exhaust the identity ball through radius 3 and all outgoing edges from the target ball frontier at exact radius 3, which covers the target ball through radius 4. Stop after checking the full 2,543,744 radius-four edges against the identity ball; do not extend the word-length ceiling if no intersection occurs.
evidence: Exact F2[UT3(F2)] search: 56 paid generators; identity and target layer counts [1,56,1750,45424]; zero radius-three intersections; all 2,543,744 edges from target radius-three frontier checked with zero identity-ball hits. Exact direct eight-call word verified independently by coefficient convolution, so the minimum in this model is eight. See CERTIFICATE.json and verify.py.
